# VIVA – Benchmark Data Analysis

> VIVA is a browser app (PWA) to visualize, interact with, verify and analyze benchmark data of optimization solvers. Data is loaded from trace or JSON files and is processed locally in the browser.

## App

- [Table](https://viva-app.xyz/table): the benchmark data as an interactive table
- [Compare Solvers](https://viva-app.xyz/compare): compare the results of solvers
- [Performance profile](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/performance-profile): performance profile plot
- [Solution quality](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/solution-quality): solution quality plot
- [Solution time](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/solution-time): solution time plot
- [Solver time per instance](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/solver-time-per-instance): solver time per instance plot
- [Solver time per solver](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/solver-time-per-solver): solver time per solver plot
- [Number of nodes](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/number-of-nodes): number of nodes plot
- [Number of iterations](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/number-of-iterations): number of iterations plot
- [Termination status](https://viva-app.xyz/plots/termination-status): termination status plot

## Documentation and source

- [Documentation](https://viva-app.xyz/Docs/documents/USER_GUIDE.html): user guide and API documentation
